title: finding(app-shell): the Debug run renders an unmodelled token embedded in a longer string (`{NOW()}`, `{$User.Email}`, `{n + 1}`) as '' — a silent fake where the runtime renders its value
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a). The Debug run shows a value the runtime would not produce, silently, against the app-shell README's own "surfaced loudly instead of faked" rule. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the contract review of PR objectui#10672 (objectui#10615) at `7f49154`, which measured it. It is pre-existing, and base gives the same answers. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Measurement (the review's probe through the real `FlowSimulator`; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

| input | Debug run | runtime |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `'at {NOW()}'` | `'at '` | a timestamp |
| `'to {$User.Email}'` | `'to '` | the email |
| `'v={n + 1}'` with `n = 2` | `'v='` | `'v=3'` |

A WHOLE-token string holding one of these is kept as written (PR objectui#10672 states this). The embedded case is not stated anywhere except in that PR's round-2 body.

## Site

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/simulator/flow-simulator.ts`, `interpolateValue` (after PR objectui#10672, it mirrors the runtime's `builtin/template.ts` for the tokens it models).

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Surface the unmodelled token loudly. For example, keep the embedded token as written and flag it on the step, the same as the whole-token rule. Or model the pure tokens the runtime computes (`NOW()`, `TODAY()`, arithmetic, `round` / `floor` / `ceil` / `abs` / `min` / `max`). Pin all three embedded cases. ⛔ Serial: PR objectui#10672 edits this function; claim this after it merges.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-24T00:00Z (777 items), with titles matched against `interpolat|unmodelled|NOW\(\)`: only PR objectui#10555 (the record-title interpolator, closed) and objectui#10447 / objectui#10434 (record titles), none about the simulator.

Dedupe words: `simulator embedded token renders empty` · `Debug run NOW() interpolation` · `interpolateValue unmodelled token`
